mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forge_outbox (id, tenant_id, topic, tag, payload) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{topic}, #{tag}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb))
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, topic, tag, CAST(payload AS text) AS payload, attempts FROM forge_outbox WHERE sent_at IS NULL AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY next_attempt_at, id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE forge_outbox SET sent_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
